definition:

adj. 冬天的；越冬的
vi. 过冬
exampleSentence: Winter is the best time to enjoy the snow.
exampleTranslation: 冬天是享受雪景的最佳时节。

definition:
adj. 明智的；聪明的；博学的
vt. 使知道；教导
vi. 了解
exampleSentence: It is wise to save money for the future.
exampleTranslation: 为未来存钱是明智的。

definition: adv. 明智地；聪明地；精明地
exampleSentence: He acted wisely by not taking the risky investment.
exampleTranslation: 他明智地没有接受那个高风险投资。

definition:
n. 希望；祝福；心愿
vt. 祝愿；渴望；向…致问候语
vi. 愿望；需要
exampleSentence: I wish I could travel around the world.
exampleTranslation: 我希望我能环游世界。

definition: prep. 用；随着；支持；和…在一起
exampleSentence: He worked with a brush and paint.
exampleTranslation: 他用画笔和颜料作画。

definition:
prep. 没有；超过；在…外面
n. 外部；外面
adv. 户外；在外面；没有或不显示某事物
exampleSentence: Name one example of capitalism working without slavery, prison labor, or sweatshops.
exampleTranslation: 举一个资本主义在没有奴隶制、监狱劳工或血汗工厂的情况下运作的例子。

definition:
n. 狼；色狼；残忍贪婪之人
vt. 大吃；狼吞虎咽地吃
exampleSentence: He wolfed down his dinner without even tasting it.
exampleTranslation: 他狼吞虎咽地吃完了晚餐，连味道都没尝。

definition: n. 妇女；女性；成年女子
exampleSentence: The woman in the red dress is my aunt.
exampleTranslation: 穿红裙子的那位女士是我的姑姑。

definition:
n. 惊奇；奇迹；惊愕
adj. 奇妙的；非凡的
vi. 怀疑；想知道；惊讶
vt. 怀疑；惊奇；对…感到惊讶
exampleSentence: I wonder if she will come to the party.
exampleTranslation: 我想知道她是否会来参加聚会。

definition: adj. 极好的，精彩的，绝妙的；奇妙的；美妙；胜；神妙
exampleSentence: This performance was truly wonderful, leaving everyone in awe.
exampleTranslation: 这场表演真是精彩绝伦，让所有人都感到惊叹。

definition:
n. 木材；木制品；树林
vt. 植林于；给…添加木柴
vi. 收集木材
exampleSentence: The carpenter used wood to build a beautiful table.
exampleTranslation: 木匠用木材做了一张漂亮的桌子。

definition: adj. 木制的；僵硬的，呆板的
exampleSentence: Her wooden expression made it clear she was not happy.
exampleTranslation: 她木然的表情表明她并不开心。

definition: n. 羊毛；毛线；绒线；毛织品；毛料衣物
exampleSentence: Private bison producers are raising bison for meat, wool and other bison-based commodities in all 50 states.
exampleTranslation: 私人养牛场正在全美50个州饲养水牛，以生产肉类、羊毛和其他基于水牛的产品。

definition:
n. 毛织品
adj. 羊毛的；羊毛制的
exampleSentence: The woolen sweater kept me warm during the cold winter.
exampleTranslation: 那件毛衣在寒冷的冬天里让我感到温暖。

definition:
n. [语] 单词；话语；消息；诺言；命令
vt. 用言辞表达
exampleSentence: He gave a word of warning before leaving the room.
exampleTranslation: 他离开房间前给了一个警告。

definition:
n. 工作；[物] 功；产品；操作；职业；行为；事业；工厂；著作；文学、音乐或艺术作品
vt. 使工作；操作；经营；使缓慢前进
vi. 工作；运作；起作用
exampleSentence: She is looking for a new job because her current work is not satisfying.
exampleTranslation: 她正在寻找一份新工作，因为目前的工作让她不满意。

definition:
n. 工作日
adj. 日常的，工作日的；平凡的
exampleSentence: The company operates on a five-day workday.
exampleTranslation: 这家公司实行五天的工作日制度。

definition: n. 工人；劳动者；职蚁
exampleSentence: Retirement is the moment when the worker ceases his activity to rest.
exampleTranslation: 退休是工人停止工作休息的时刻。

definition: n. 世界；领域；世俗；全人类；物质生活
exampleSentence: The world we live in does not obey the norms of reactionaries.
exampleTranslation: 我们所生活的世界并不遵守反动派的规范。

definition: adj. 担心的
exampleSentence: We were worried about her ashen appearance.
exampleTranslation: 我们担心她的面色苍白。

definition:
n. 担心；烦恼；撕咬
vi. 担心；烦恼；撕咬
vt. 担心；发愁；折磨
exampleSentence: Don't worry but question the gourd!
exampleTranslation: 别担心，但要质疑这个葫芦！

definition:
n. 更坏的事；更恶劣的事
adj. 更坏的；更差的；更恶劣的（bad的比较级）；（病情）更重的（ill的比较级）
adv. 更糟；更坏；更恶劣地；更坏地
exampleSentence: Things are going to get worse before they get better.
exampleTranslation: 情况在好转之前会变得更糟。

definition:
n. 最坏；最坏的时候
adj. 最差的，最坏的；最不利的；效能最低的
adv. 最坏地；最不利地
exampleSentence: It was the best of times, it was the worst of times.
exampleTranslation: 这是最好的时代，也是最坏的时代。

definition:
n. 价值；财产
adj. 值…的
exampleSentence: The painting is worth millions of dollars.
exampleTranslation: 这幅画价值数百万美元。

definition:
aux. 将，将要；愿意
v. will的过去式
exampleSentence: I would swim through the ocean just to see your smile again.
exampleTranslation: 我愿意游过海洋只为再次看到你的笑容。

definition:
n. 创伤，伤口
vt. 使受伤
vi. 受伤，伤害
exampleSentence: The separation felt like an open wound that wouldn’t heal.
exampleTranslation: 这段分离的感觉就像一个无法愈合的伤口。

definition:
n. 受伤者，伤员
v. 使受伤（wound的过去分词）
adj. 受伤的
exampleSentence: Three servicemen tend to a wounded serviceman who is supine on a hospital bed.
exampleTranslation: 三名士兵照顾着一名躺在医院病床上的伤员。

definition:
vi. 写，写字；写作，作曲；写信
vt. 写，书写；写信给；著述
exampleSentence: She decided to write a letter to her grandmother.
exampleTranslation: 她决定给祖母写一封信。

definition: n. 作家；作者
exampleSentence: Shloyme wants to be a writer.
exampleTranslation: 什洛伊梅想成为一名作家。

definition:
n. 坏事；不公正
adj. 错误的；失常的；不适当的
vt. 委屈；无理地对待；诽谤
adv. 错误地；邪恶地，不正当地
exampleSentence: He did something wrong by breaking the rules.
exampleTranslation: 他违反了规则，犯了错误。

definition:
n. 伦琴射线；X光；X光照片
adj. 伦琴线的
v. 用X线检查[摄影,处理,治疗]
exampleSentence: The doctor used X-ray to examine the patient's chest.
exampleTranslation: 医生用X光检查了病人的胸部。

definition:
n. 院子；码（英制中丈量长度单位，1码=3英尺）；庭院；帆桁
vt. 把…关进或围在畜栏里
exampleSentence: The dog was yarded in the barn overnight.
exampleTranslation: 这只狗被关在谷仓里过了一整晚。

definition: n. 年；年度；历年；年纪；一年的期间；某年级的学生
exampleSentence: She is in her third year at university.
exampleTranslation: 她正在大学读第三年。

definition:
n. 黄色；黄种人；黄色颜料
adj. 黄色的；黄皮肤的
vt. 使变黄或发黄
vi. 变黄或发黄
exampleSentence: The sun caused the paper to yellow over time.
exampleTranslation: 太阳使纸张随着时间变黄。

definition:
n. 是（表示肯定）
adv. 是, 是的
exampleSentence: Did you understand the question? Yes, I did.
exampleTranslation: 你明白这个问题吗？是的，我明白了。

definition:
n. 昨天；往昔
adv. 昨天
exampleSentence: I met my friend yesterday, but I didn't call him today.
exampleTranslation: 我昨天见了朋友，但今天没给他打电话。

definition:
conj. 但是；然而
adv. 还；但是；已经
n. 酸奶酪，[食品] 酸乳（等于yoghurt）
exampleSentence: He eats yogurt with honey every day.
exampleTranslation: 他每天吃酸奶配蜂蜜。

definition: pron. 你；你们
exampleSentence: You are doing a great job.
exampleTranslation: 你做得很好。

definition:
n. 年轻人；（动物的）崽，仔
adj. 年轻的；初期的；没有经验的
exampleSentence: The young deer was playing in the meadow.
exampleTranslation: 小鹿在草地上玩耍。

definition: pron. 你的，你们的
exampleSentence: This book is yours, so please take good care of it.
exampleTranslation: 这本书是你的，所以请好好保管。

definition:
pron. 你（们）的东西；你的责任[义务]；你的家属；来信，尊函
adj. 你（们）的（东西）；信末署名前用语
exampleSentence: It's yours to complete the task on time.
exampleTranslation: 这是你的责任按时完成任务。

definition: pron. 你自己
exampleSentence: Can you start out by telling us a little bit about yourself?
exampleTranslation: 你能先告诉我们一些关于你自己的事情吗？

definition: pron. 你们自己；你们本人（yourself的复数）
exampleSentence: Get OK with yourselves and the right person will come along.
exampleTranslation: 你们先接受自己，合适的人就会出现。

definition:
n. [脊椎] 斑马
adj. 有斑纹的
exampleSentence: The zebra is known for its distinctive black and white stripes.
exampleTranslation: 斑马以其独特的黑白条纹而闻名。

definition:
num. 零
n. 零点，零度
exampleSentence: The temperature dropped to zero and the water froze immediately.
exampleTranslation: 温度降至零度，水立刻结冰了。

definition: [人名] 齐珀
exampleSentence: She pulled the zipper up slowly to avoid damaging it.
exampleTranslation: 她慢慢地拉上拉链，以免损坏它。

definition: n. 动物园; <美俚>（铁路货车的最后一节）守车; <美俚>核粒子园
exampleSentence: We visited the zoo and saw many animals.
exampleTranslation: 我们参观了动物园，看到了许多动物。
